offset.description:
The column number of the line that causes the user code error. If offset can't be extracted from the exception, the
default offset is 0.

lineno.description:
The line number causing {@link #error} in the user code. If the line number can't be extracted from the exception,
the default offset is 0.

error.description: The error message when saving the user code

title: The type to show the user code error with the line number.
name: DataValidation.Rule.Lambda.Issue
